title: UPI's expanding cross-border footprint
summary: UPI is now live in **10+ countries** — Singapore, UAE, Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, France, Mauritius, Qatar, Cambodia, Greece (P2P-only) — with two new corridors added this fortnight: Maldives and Qatar.

blocks.content: UPI is now live in **10+ countries** — Singapore, UAE, Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, France, Mauritius, Qatar, Cambodia, Greece (P2P-only) — with two new corridors added this fortnight: Maldives and Qatar.

items: **Favara-UPI (India–Maldives)**: Maldives' Favara instant-payment system linked with UPI; real-time transfers Maldives→India (Rufiyaa→INR); Phase 1 banks: Bank of Maldives Plc & Maldives Islamic Bank Plc; built with Maldives Monetary Authority + RBI + NPCI International (NIPL)

**PosTransfer (Qatar–India)**: Qatar Post customers can send money directly to UPI-enabled Indian accounts; built by Qatar Post + India Post + Universal Postal Union's Interconnection Platform (UPU-IP) + NIPL

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Growing UPI cross-border list; this fortnight added Maldives (Favara) + Qatar (PosTransfer) — consolidate as one "UPI international expansion 2026" revision point. Greece is P2P-only — don't conflate with full-UPI-live countries.
